propositions: Operator-attested evidence lacks declared measurement context (environment, principal, privilege, instrument type), allowing escapes like wrong-account attestations and privilege-masked validation to pass undetected
The existing attestation contract verifies provenance of the attestation event but not the measurement event, creating a trust gap where cached/simulated/out-of-scope measurements satisfy the gate

A deterministic check must enforce presence of four non-placeholder provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) on every [operator-attested] criterion, without judging correctness

An LLM-tier AGENT criterion must detect contradictions between declared measurement environment and repository-anchored facts (e.g., Terraform backend), requiring tool-enabled execution mode to read IaC

The instrument field must independently flag simulation/static-analysis evidence against authorization claims, even when privilege_posture is production-equivalent, to catch the simulate-principal-policy false-positive escape
All mechanism (DET check, overlay wiring, rubric prompt, syntax binding) ships advisory and never blocks, so pre-contract attestations remain valid without migration
